claim.reading: The arithmetic mean of age over all rows equals 22 when rounded to the printed precision.

message: Under the stated reading, the data file does not give the printed number.
proposal_origin_note: Who proposed this reading. A proposer has no authority; only the checks below count.

assumptions: Rounding: the printed value 22 stands for any exact value within ±1/2 of it (rounding to the last printed digit, ties accepted either way).
Missing values: cells equal to one of ['', 'NA'] are excluded; the count of excluded rows is part of the proof.
Every other cell in the columns used is read as an exact decimal number; no rows are added, removed or reweighted.

open_obligations: Whether this file is the data the authors actually analysed (custody and completeness).
Whether sampling, measurement and exclusions make the statistic meaningful for the question asked.
Whether any comparison, trend or causal reading drawn from the number is justified.

scope: REFUTED, for the data file mackerel3D_burst_routine.csv (SHA-256 27a4372092b2e6dd…) only: “The arithmetic mean of age over all rows equals 22 when rounded to the printed precision.” This shows a mismatch between the printed number and this file under this reading. It does not show that the paper is wrong: the reading may be mistaken, or the authors may have analysed different rows or a different file version.
